apps.name: ClearMind: AI To-Do Journal (Hacked)
apps.localizedDescription:
ClearMind is an AI thought journal, to-do list, and focus planner for everything your mind keeps trying to hold.

Capture anything
Speak or type messy thoughts, tasks, worries, ideas, decisions, goals, reminders, and random notes. You do not need to be clear or organized first. ClearMind catches the mental load as it comes.

Let AI sort it
Your thoughts are gently organized into useful spaces: tasks, notes, worries, ideas, questions, decisions, contacts, or your own personal categories. Use the classic ClearMind organization, or create a custom system that matches the way your life actually works.

Move from thought to action
When something needs to get done, ClearMind turns it into a task with the right context. Add deadlines, reminder
